response_rubric.statement: Distinguish measured OAR dose ranking from unverified geometric proximity/clinical harm; use known D2cc7.3/4.8Gy without asserting they are spatially nearest.
No invented centroid/distance or unrequested new segmentation.
Any proximity claim requires actual geometric source, not organ volume/model-name inference.
